senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Σεβαστή) Sebaste, built by Herod on the site of the old Samaria (Shomron).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 6:1">Am. VI, 1</cite>) that means the ten tribes <he>שהיו יושבים לבטח בס׳</he> (not <he>שיושבים</he>) who dwelt safely in S.; Tanḥ. Sh’mini 5 <he>בסְבַסְטְיָא</he>.
